attribute uses the term “source highlighter”, whereas the library that performs the highlighting is referred to as a “syntax highlighter”. What’s the difference?
The generally accepted term for a syntax (aka code) highlighter is “syntax highlighter”.
The syntax highlighter is applied to source blocks in AsciiDoc, hence why we say “source highlighter”.
attribute means “use this syntax highlighter to colorize source blocks”.
